answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 21892 Country: Pakistan Title: what is your openion about celebrating the program of gayarwe sahreef? Question: Assalamoalikom what is your openion about celebrating the program of gayarwe sahreef? Answer ID: 21892 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim !
